findings: Current api/scalp-models.js exposes three experimental models (Liquidity Sweep, FVG Retracement, Trend Pullback), not the requested integrated seven-gate strategy.
Liquidity Sweep implementation scans recent M5 bars and a 10-bar rolling range; it does not verify H1 and M15 liquidity sweeps together.
FVG model identifies a three-candle gap and later touch/fill, but it does not require the complete sequence sweep -> CHOCH -> BOS -> displacement -> retracement.
No explicit Premium/Discount dealing-range gate or London/New York session gate exists in the experimental model.
buildScalpModels explicitly returns backtested:false; its candidates are not a historical backtest.
Existing research/backtest-summary.json uses different date ranges (M5 ends 2026-09-24); supplied CSV ends 2026-10-20. Its reported metrics must not be attributed to this CSV.
CSV has 366 intervals greater than 5 minutes; these gaps require session/data-quality review before interpreting results.
decision: NOT PASS: no valid Phase 2 backtest for the requested seven-gate model exists yet; 80% win-rate target remains unverified.
